evidence.title: Crawl4AI: the open-source web crawler for LLMs and AI agents

name: Crawl4AI
summary: Open-source web crawler and scraper that turns websites into clean Markdown and structured JSON for LLMs.
description: Python crawler built for LLM pipelines: clean and fit Markdown with citation lists, structured extraction via CSS/XPath schemas or any LLM, deep crawling (BFS/DFS/best-first) with adaptive stopping, plus screenshots, PDFs and media. Runs as a library, CLI or Docker server with REST API, dashboard and MCP, or as a hosted cloud with /scrape, /extract, /search, /serp and /answer.
contains: LLM-ready Markdown: headings, tables, code blocks and a citation list
extraction: CSS/XPath/LLM strategies, schema generator and chunking
deep crawl BFS/DFS/best-first with crash recovery; adaptive crawling
Apache-2.0 with badge attribution; latest release v0.9.4 (Sep 2026)
